channel.title: America First Transcripts
channel.description: Searchable transcripts of America First, hosted by Nick Fuentes: every episode, line by line, with timestamps linked to the video.

item.title: Ep. 1771: ICE AGENTS DOXED??? Left Wing HACKTIVISTS DOX All ICE Agents
item.description: Nick argues that a left-wing group's doxxing of 41,000 ICE agents previews a left-wing takeover after the midterms, that Trump used federal power for Israel, not against the left, and that only the left destroying the GOP can open the way for the radical right.

item.title: Ep. 1770: NETANYAHU SURVIVES??? Israeli Elections FAIL To Topple Netanyahu Government
item.description: Nick argues that Netanyahu, surviving Israel's election as caretaker, will try to provoke a new Iran war the US cannot win, and that Trump's endorsement of Netanyahu shows Trumpism serves Israel, so Republicans must lose next week.

item.title: Ep. 1769: THE END OF NETANYAHU??? Israeli PM FAILS To Trigger New IRAN WAR
item.description: Nick praises Groypers who appeared in America First hats behind Trump and Vance at rallies, and argues an Israeli report shows Netanyahu tried to restart the Iran war to stay in power and expand Israel at America's expense.

item.title: Ep. 1768: LEWANDOWSKI INVESTIGATED??? Kristi Noem "BOYFRIEND" PROBED By DOJ
item.description: Nick covers the DOJ probe into Corey Lewandowski over alleged pay-to-play at DHS under Kristi Noem, which he calls systemic corruption, and argues Democratic investigations after the midterms will make Vance or anyone in the administration unelectable in 2028.

item.title: Ep. 1767: IRAN WAR DAY 237: US Preparing To Resume MAJOR COMBAT OPERATIONS
item.description: Nick argues Vance, Vivek Ramaswamy and Tucker Carlson are one coup against Trumpism, covers US plans to resume major combat with Iran, which he says Israel is provoking, and calls for firing Susie Wiles over her allies' influence peddling in Bosnia.

item.title: Ep. 1766: VIVEK ATTACK AD BACKFIRES??? Vivek Runs EVIL ATTACK AD Targeting AMY ACTON
item.description: Nick argues Vivek Ramaswamy's attack ad using Amy Acton's mother, who lost custody over her boyfriend's abuse of the children, reflects Indian culture, and that the defenses of it by Dinesh D'Souza and Megyn Kelly show Indian tribalism and media loyalty to the GOP.

item.title: Ep. 1765: FRANCE RACE RIOTS??? "Mostly Peaceful" ANIMALS Destroy PARIS
item.description: Nick argues Vance's CBS town hall shows him trapped by the Iran war and Trump's record, and that Vance's swipe at him, as an unnamed 'podcaster', dodges Vance's friendship with Tucker Carlson, then covers the French riots, which he calls race riots by migrants who must all be sent back.

item.title: Ep. 1764: IRAN WAR DAY 230: Houthis Impose AIR BLOCKADE On Saudi Arabia
item.description: Nick argues Trump could have been a transformative Groyper president had he broken with Israel, then covers the Houthi air blockade of Saudi Arabia and Trump's pressure on Ukraine over Russian oil, which he says expose the limits of American power.

item.title: Ep. 1763: GROYPER TAKEOVER??? Ted Cruz WARNS Of TOTAL GROYPER OCCUPATION
item.description: Nick turns Buckley Carlson's fed accusation back on the Carlson family's CIA and Palantir ties and a push to build Vance's 2028 base, then covers Ted Cruz saying Groypers fill his job applicants, which he calls proof his strategy of entering GOP offices works.

item.title: Ep. 1762: ILHAN OMAR RAIDED??? Trump DOJ TARGETS Muslim SOCIALIST
item.description: Nick covers the FBI raid on Ilhan Omar's home, which he backs in principle but calls a pre-election stunt the administration won't follow through on, and Kimberly Guilfoyle's resignation, which he says shows the administration is a criminal enterprise.

item.title: Ep. 1761: TRAIN HOE EXPOSED??? Legal "GANG BANG" Confirmed In NEW TEXTS
item.description: Nick covers the newly published TMZ texts in the Cornell case, which he calls a liberal hoax refuted in record time, and NatCon's Jerusalem conference, which he argues is a Straussian project to tie American nationalism to Israel.

item.title: Ep. 1760: NATCON JERUSALEM??? "Nationalists" Gather In Israel
item.description: Nick argues NatCon's Jerusalem conference, led by an Israeli dual citizen and barring white nationalists and Israel critics, is meant to make a pro-Israel agenda inseparable from the right, and that American nationalism must affirm race.

item.title: Ep. 1759: ANTISEMITES DEPORTED??? Rabbi BRAGS 250k Antisemites DEPORTED Under Trump
item.description: Nick argues conservative women are closeted feminists and the Cornell accuser is as culpable as the men, then covers the antisemitism envoy's claim of 250,000 revoked visas, arguing government tolerates displacement but not antisemitism.

item.title: Ep. 1758: VIVEK DROPS BABY??? WEAKEST RACE, Indian, DROPS BABY On Stage
item.description: Nick covers Vivek Ramaswamy dropping a baby on stage and Dinesh D'Souza posting the child's name, arguing Indians do not assimilate, then argues the Iran war is a stalemate of economic attrition as Gulf oil exports recover.

item.title: Brandon Straka Interviews Nick Fuentes
item.description: In an interview with Brandon Straka, Nick recounts his break with the conservative establishment, accepts the official account of Charlie Kirk's killing, criticizes Candace Owens, predicts a midterm rout and says who is welcome in his movement.

item.title: Ep. 1757: IRAN WAR DAY 217: Trump PREPARES For Post-Midterm WAR
item.description: Nick calls the Cornell case a hoax, argues women lack accountability and that feminism must be eradicated, then covers the US buildup of carriers and Marines for Iran, arguing it is likely intimidation and Trump will take a sham deal.

item.title: Ep. 1756: ISRAEL 9/11 ATTACK??? Airliner HIJACKED, Netanyahu WARNED US???
item.description: Nick covers the hijacking of an Israeli-passenger airliner and Netanyahu's terror warning before his election, arguing a false flag would fit his need for an Iran war, and argues women lack accountability, citing the Cornell case.

item.title: Ep. 1755: GOP HATES WHITE PEOPLE??? Sarah Huckabee Sanders ATTACKS White Men
item.description: Nick covers Sarah Huckabee Sanders' ad showing a young white man as a welfare abuser, arguing the GOP does not care about young white men and urging viewers to take over the party, then Iran's seven-day proposal and enrichment as the obstacle.

item.title: Ep. 1754: FUENTES VS JIANG DEBATE RECAP??? Federal Agent And Chinese Spy COLLIDE
item.description: In a recap of his Jack Neal debate with Professor Jiang, Nick argues Jews are an ethnic-religious group acting on a group strategy, rebuts the Sabbatian and Khazarian theories, and sets out the America First position.

item.title: Nick Fuentes vs. Professor Jiang: Who Actually Runs the World?
item.description: On the Jack Neal podcast, Nick debates Professor Jiang, arguing Israel is drawing Trump into the Iran war, that Chabad is one faction of world Jewry, rejecting secret society theories, and stating his Christian view of Jesus.

item.title: Ep. 1753: IRAN WAR DAY 209: Iran Proposes PEACE DEAL At UN General Assembly
item.description: Nick covers Iran's seven-day peace proposal at the UN, arguing Iran wants everything up front and Washington won't accept it, then reads Trump's 32% approval and says Trump bowed to donors and Israel.

item.title: Ep. 1752: LOWEST APPROVAL EVER??? Trump's Approval Rating COLLAPSES To 28%
item.description: Nick covers megadonor Tim Mellon withholding money from Senate Republicans over the SAVE Act, arguing voters can boycott the GOP too, lists Trump's broken promises, and tells viewers to stay home in 2026.

item.title: Ep. 1751: ANNIHILATE IRAN??? Trump THREATENS To DESTROY IRAN At UN Speech
item.description: Nick argues the viral Indian crowd at a Texas game shows America turning non-white and that Vance, Gill and Ramaswamy stay silent because of Indian ties, then covers Trump's UN speech threatening Iran, saying immigration is the real threat.

item.title: Ep. 1750: TRUMP ANNEXES GREENLAND??? Trump Secures Greenland For America
item.description: Nick covers Trump's ban of three outlets from the press pool, calling the media the left's enforcer, and argues the Greenland deal mostly formalizes the status quo and the US should have acquired the island outright.

item.title: Ep. 1749: IRAN WAR DAY 202: Saudi Arabia DRAGS America Into Yemen
item.description: Nick condemns Dan Bilzerian's call on Sneako's stream to target Israeli leaders, covers Saudi Arabia's pleas for US help in the Iran war, and says arrests are surging while deportations stay flat.

item.title: Ep. 1748: VANCE EXPOSED??? FAT Race-Traitor HELPED HILARY CLINTON
item.description: Nick covers a Vanity Fair profile of JD Vance, arguing that Vance's 2016 never-Trump record and newly reported advice to Hillary Clinton's campaign disqualify him, and that Vance is owned by tech and will fail in 2028.

item.title: Ep. 1747: JEWS CANCEL ED SHEERAN??? ZIONIST Robert Kraft SHUTS DOWN Macklemore
item.description: Nick calls the Ed Sheeran tour dispute, where venue owners like Robert Kraft demanded Macklemore be fired, the best case study of Jewish power, then covers the Iran war's economic phase and attacks on Saudi oil.

item.title: Ep. 1746: INDIANS TAKEOVER UT??? Texas Football Game INVADED BY INDIANS
item.description: Nick argues a viral all-Indian University of Texas crowd shows white replacement and that Ben Shapiro defended it because Jews were always a minority, then covers the Supreme Court blocking Trump's mail-in ballot order as an unforced error.

item.title: Ep. 1745: FETTERMAN SPEAKS??? Pro-Israel DEMOCRAT Speaks At RNC Convention
item.description: Nick argues Fetterman speaking at the Republican midterm convention is explained by Israel, since the GOP is the Israel-controlled party, and that Democrats will win in 2026 and 2028 in a political arms race Trump could have won.

item.title: Ep. 1744: LINDSAY CLANCY COPYCAT??? Epidemic Of PSYCHO WOMEN Murdering Babies
item.description: Nick laments how far the Israel-critical right has fallen, criticizing Tucker Carlson and Candace Owens, then covers a Haaretz report that the UAE warned Netanyahu before October 7, arguing Netanyahu let the attack happen.
